settings.sessions.recordPerformance.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Record performance metrics" (Settings → Sessions): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.sessions.resetPerformance.desc.defaultMessage: Clear this workspace's recorded performance metrics.
settings.sessions.resetPerformance.desc.description: What the setting "Reset performance metrics" does, under its title (Settings → Sessions).

settings.sessions.resetPerformance.tip.defaultMessage: Starts the history again from now. Session usage and transcripts are not affected.
settings.sessions.resetPerformance.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Reset performance metrics" (Settings → Sessions): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.sessions.resumeAfterUnexpectedC.defaultMessage: When Combwork closed without quitting (a crash, or it was ended), resume the agents that were running when it starts again.
settings.sessions.resumeAfterUnexpectedC.description: What the setting "Resume agents after an unexpected close" does, under its title (Settings → Sessions).

settings.sessions.resumeAfterUnexpectedC.defaultMessage: Off: Combwork only tells you, with Resume All for you to choose. Either way the notice says when Combwork was last seen and which agents were running.
settings.sessions.resumeAfterUnexpectedC.description: The info tip of the setting "Resume agents after an unexpected close" (Settings → Sessions): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.sessions.resumeAfterUnexpectedC.defaultMessage: Resume agents after an unexpected close

settings.sessions.tileOrder.desc.defaultMessage: The order of the agents' tiles in the Tiles view.
settings.sessions.tileOrder.desc.description: What the setting "Tile order" does, under its title (Settings → Sessions).

settings.sessions.tileOrder.option.panes.description: A choice of the setting "Tile order" (Settings → Sessions): the tiles in the panes' order. The default.

settings.sessions.tileOrder.option.urgen.description: A choice of the setting "Tile order" (Settings → Sessions): waiting for you and stalled first, then working, then idle.

settings.sessions.tileOrder.tip.defaultMessage: Same as panes keeps the agents in their panes' order, so a builder stays beside its reviewer: tiles waiting for you or stalled are highlighted where they are, and a page button counts them on other pages. By urgency puts them first, then the agents working, then the idle ones.
settings.sessions.tileOrder.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Tile order" (Settings → Sessions). "Same as panes" and "By urgency" are its choices: use their translations.

settings.sessions.tileOrder.title.description: A setting's title (Settings → Sessions): the order of the Tiles view's tiles.

settings.sessions.transcriptWarnMB.desc.defaultMessage: Size, in MB, at which a running conversation's transcript turns orange in its footer and Combwork notifies you once.
settings.sessions.transcriptWarnMB.desc.description: What the setting "Warn when a transcript is over" does, under its title (Settings → Sessions).

settings.sessions.transcriptWarnMB.off.description: The Off box of the number setting "Warn when a transcript is over" (Settings → Sessions): ticked, the setting is off (0).

settings.sessions.transcriptWarnMB.tip.defaultMessage: A long conversation slows down the CLI and Combwork: each turn, resume and transcript view has more to read. Compacting doesn't shrink the file, which keeps the whole history; handing the work over to a new conversation does (click the size in the footer for Hand Over to…, and choose the agent itself). Projects can set their own value in Project Settings.
settings.sessions.transcriptWarnMB.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Warn when a transcript is over" (Settings → Sessions): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.sessions.transcriptWarnMB.title.defaultMessage: Warn when a transcript is over

settings.sessions.usageCacheClear.desc.defaultMessage: Forget what the cache holds; a transcript it had is read again when it is next needed. The usage history stays.
settings.sessions.usageCacheClear.desc.description: What the setting "Clear the usage cache" does, under its title (Settings → Sessions).

settings.sessions.usageCacheClear.tip.defaultMessage: Only needed if a running session's token counts look wrong. Nothing else is lost: sessions, transcripts, backups and the usage history stay as they are.
settings.sessions.usageCacheClear.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Clear the usage cache" (Settings → Sessions): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.sessions.usageCacheSize.desc.defaultMessage: How many transcripts Combwork keeps the token use of in memory while it runs, so a running session's figures follow each turn without reading it again.
settings.sessions.usageCacheSize.desc.description: What the setting "Usage cache size" does, under its title (Settings → Sessions).

settings.sessions.usageCacheSize.tip.defaultMessage: What each session used is kept in the usage history, in the workspace's .hive folder: this cache only spares reading a transcript again while Combwork runs. The least recently used go first when it is full. {min, number} to {max, number}.
settings.sessions.usageCacheSize.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Usage cache size" (Settings → Sessions): more on what it does and when it applies. {min} and {max} are the fewest and most transcripts it can be set to.

settings.slotCopy.desc.defaultMessage: Git-ignored files copied from the project folder into each new slot and review copy, comma separated or one per line, such as .env files. Projects inherit it, and can set their own in Version Control → Slots and copies.
settings.slotCopy.desc.description: What the workflow default “Files copied into new slots” does, at Hive’s and a workspace’s level (glossary 2.5: slot, review copy). Keep .env as it is.

settings.slotCopy.title.description: A workflow default (Git) and a project setting: the git-ignored files copied from the project folder into each new slot and review copy (glossary 2.5: slot, review copy).

settings.token.copied.description: A notice after a token was copied.

settings.token.copy.description: Button beside a token: copies it.

settings.token.hide.description: Button beside a token: hides it again.

settings.token.regenerate.description: Button beside the Agent API's token: makes a new one.

settings.token.regenerateMessage.defaultMessage: Programs using the current token will stop working. Running sessions pick up the new token when restarted.
settings.token.regenerateMessage.description: The question before the Agent API's token is replaced.

settings.token.regenerateTitle.description: Title of the question before the Agent API's token is replaced.

settings.token.show.description: Button beside a hidden token: shows it.

settings.updates.checkAutomatically.desc.defaultMessage: Look for a new version of Combwork shortly after it starts and every 6 hours.
settings.updates.checkAutomatically.desc.description: What the setting "Check for updates automatically" does, under its title (Settings → Updates).

settings.updates.checkAutomatically.tip.defaultMessage: When off, Combwork only checks when you choose Help → Check for Updates…; development builds never update.
settings.updates.checkAutomatically.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Check for updates automatically" (Settings → Updates): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.updates.downloadAutomatically.d.defaultMessage: Download a new version in the background as soon as it is found.
settings.updates.downloadAutomatically.d.description: What the setting "Download updates automatically" does, under its title (Settings → Updates).

settings.updates.downloadAutomatically.t.defaultMessage: When off, the status bar says a new version is available and you choose when to download it. Downloads are checked against the release checksum.
settings.updates.downloadAutomatically.t.description: The info tip of the setting "Download updates automatically" (Settings → Updates): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.updates.install.desc.defaultMessage: When a downloaded update is installed.
settings.updates.install.desc.description: What the setting "Install updates" does, under its title (Settings → Updates).

settings.updates.install.option.auto.description: A choice of the setting "Install updates" (Settings → Updates).

settings.updates.install.option.manual.description: A choice of the setting "Install updates" (Settings → Updates).

settings.updates.install.tip.defaultMessage: Automatically: the update installs when you next quit Combwork (never while it is running, so your sessions are not interrupted); Restart and Update installs it straight away. Manually: it installs only when you choose Restart and Update. Either way, Combwork asks before stopping agents that are working.
settings.updates.install.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Install updates" (Settings → Updates): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.updates.prerelease.desc.defaultMessage: Also offer beta versions published before a full release.
settings.updates.prerelease.desc.description: What the setting "Include pre-releases" does, under its title (Settings → Updates).

settings.updates.prerelease.tip.defaultMessage: Pre-releases get new features first and may have rough edges. Turning this off again waits for the next full release rather than going back.
settings.updates.prerelease.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Include pre-releases" (Settings → Updates): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.updates.status.tip.defaultMessage: The version you are running and the result of the last check.
settings.updates.status.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Hive Desktop version" (Settings → Updates): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.usageCache.clear.description: Button of Settings → Sessions → Clear the usage cache.

settings.usageCache.clearFailed.defaultMessage: Could not clear the usage cache
settings.usageCache.clearFailed.description: An error's title: clearing the usage cache failed.

settings.usageCache.cleared.description: A notice after Settings → Sessions → Clear the usage cache.

settings.usageCache.clearedDetail.defaultMessage: Each transcript is read again the next time it is shown.
settings.usageCache.clearedDetail.description: More in the notice after the usage cache was cleared.

settings.viewers.made.description: A notice after a viewer token was made (Settings → Agent API → Viewer tokens). {name} is the name the user gave it.

settings.viewers.madeColumn.description: A column of the viewer tokens table: when the token was made.

settings.viewers.madeDetail.defaultMessage: Copy it into the app it is for.
settings.viewers.madeDetail.description: More in the notice after a viewer token was made.

settings.viewers.make.description: Button: makes a viewer token with the name typed beside it.

settings.viewers.makeFailed.defaultMessage: Could not make the viewer token
settings.viewers.makeFailed.description: An error's title: making a viewer token failed.

settings.viewers.name.description: A column of the viewer tokens table: the name the user gave a token.

settings.viewers.nameLabel.description: The name, for screen readers, of the box where a new viewer token's name is typed.

settings.viewers.namePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the box where a new viewer token's name is typed. Apiary is an app's name: keep it.

settings.viewers.revokeFailed.defaultMessage: Could not revoke the viewer token
settings.viewers.revokeFailed.description: An error's title: revoking a viewer token failed.

settings.viewers.revokeMessage.defaultMessage: The app using it can no longer read Combwork, and its event stream ends now.
settings.viewers.revokeMessage.description: The question before a viewer token is revoked.

settings.viewers.revokeTitle.description: Title of the question before a viewer token is revoked. {name} is its name.

settings.viewers.token.description: A column of the viewer tokens table: the token.

settings.viewers.tokenOf.description: The name, for screen readers, of a viewer token's box. {name} is the token's name.

settings.workflow.hiveDefaults.desc.defaultMessage: For every workspace: what each project starts from unless its workspace or the project sets its own. Pick a preset, or set each option, for None or for Git.
settings.workflow.hiveDefaults.desc.description: What the setting "Hive defaults" is, under its title (Settings → Version Control). None and Git: glossary 2.1.

settings.workflow.hiveDefaults.tip.defaultMessage: Until 1.0’s settings tidy, Settings → Workflow defaults: nothing set there changed.
settings.workflow.hiveDefaults.tip.description: The info tip of "Hive defaults" (Settings → Version Control): its old place, so a search for its old name finds it. Workflow defaults was the old section’s name: translate it as that section was.

settings.workflow.hiveDefaults.title.description: A setting's title (Settings → Version Control): the workflow options every project of every workspace starts from (Darren's words, HI-1768).

settings.workflow.tabs.description: Accessible name of Settings → Version Control's tabs: Hive defaults and the open workspace's (HI-1837).

settings.workflow.workspaceDefaults.desc.defaultMessage: For this workspace’s projects, over Combwork defaults; a project sets its own in its Version Control tab.
settings.workflow.workspaceDefaults.desc.description: What the setting "Workspace defaults" is, under its title (Settings → Version Control). Hive defaults and the Version Control tab: names as Hive shows them.

settings.workflow.workspaceDefaults.tip.defaultMessage: Until 1.0’s settings tidy, the workflow defaults in Settings → Workspace: nothing set there changed.
settings.workflow.workspaceDefaults.tip.description: The info tip of "Workspace defaults" (Settings → Version Control): its old place, so a search for it finds it.

settings.workflow.workspaceDefaults.titl.description: A setting's title (Settings → Version Control): the workflow options the open workspace's projects start from, over Hive defaults (HI-1768). The window shows the workspace's name beside it.

settings.workflow.workspaceDefaultsNamed.description: The title of the part of Settings → Version Control holding the open workspace’s workflow defaults; {workspace} is its name.

settings.workspace.antivirus.desc.defaultMessage: Whether Microsoft Defender scans the workspace's folders as Combwork's work changes them (builds, tests, git, worktrees), and the exclusions Combwork can add for them, with your consent.
settings.workspace.antivirus.desc.description: What the setting "Antivirus scanning" does, under its title (Settings → Workspace).

settings.workspace.antivirus.tip.defaultMessage: Combwork checks without administrator rights, so Defender may not show its exclusions (unknown). Adding or removing exclusions asks for administrator rights once. Combwork only ever offers these folders: the workspace, its worktrees folder once it exists, and its test area for people developing Combwork. It never changes other antivirus products.
settings.workspace.antivirus.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Antivirus scanning" (Settings → Workspace): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.workspace.commands.desc.defaultMessage: This workspace's own commands: run one by hand (here, or Run Command in the command palette), or pick it, or one of Combwork's, for when this workspace opens or closes.
settings.workspace.commands.desc.description: What the setting "Commands" does, under its title (Settings → Workspace, HI-1954).

settings.workspace.commands.tip.defaultMessage: Saved in the workspace's .hive/workspace.json, which Combwork keeps out of version control. Only you can set them: the Assistant can't change them.
settings.workspace.commands.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Commands" (Settings → Workspace, HI-1954). Keep the file path as it is.

settings.workspace.commands.title.description: A setting's title (Settings → Workspace): the user's own named commands for this workspace (HI-1954).

settings.workspace.hiddenProjects.desc.defaultMessage: Restore one to bring it back with its cards (and, for a removed one, the handovers packed into its folder). A folder that has left the workspace can be forgotten.
settings.workspace.hiddenProjects.desc.description: What the setting "Hidden and removed projects" does, under its title (Settings → Workspace).

settings.workspace.hiddenProjects.tip.defaultMessage: Project → Remove Project… hides a project, removes it from Combwork (its folder keeps its handovers and cards in .hive/removed, so it can move to another workspace) or deletes it (to the Recycle Bin). Deleted projects are not listed here: restore the folder from the Recycle Bin and Combwork sees it as a new project.
settings.workspace.hiddenProjects.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Hidden and removed projects" (Settings → Workspace): more on what it does and when it applies.

settings.workspace.onClose.desc.defaultMessage: The commands Combwork runs, in order, as this workspace closes: its window closes, another workspace opens in it, or Combwork quits. Combwork waits for them, showing them running.
settings.workspace.onClose.desc.description: What the setting "When this workspace closes, run" does, under its title (Settings → Workspace; HI-1954: a list of the user's commands).

settings.workspace.onClose.tip.defaultMessage: Pick them from Commands above. '{workspace}' becomes the workspace's folder, '{name}' its name and '{reason}' why it closes: window, switch, quit, or update when Combwork restarts to install an update (only with that box ticked). Only you can set them: the Assistant can't change them.
settings.workspace.onClose.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "When this workspace closes, run" (Settings → Workspace; HI-1954). '{workspace}', '{name}' and '{reason}' are placeholders the user writes in a command, and window, switch, quit and update are the values {reason} becomes: keep them all as they are (the quotes around each placeholder keep it from being read as one of this text). Commands is the title of the setting above.

settings.workspace.onClose.title.description: A setting's title (Settings → Workspace): a command of the user's that Hive runs as the open workspace closes.

settings.workspace.onOpen.desc.defaultMessage: The commands Combwork runs, in order, as this workspace opens: a local server or a database its agents need, say. Its agents start once they're done, or once you choose Don't wait.
settings.workspace.onOpen.desc.description: What the setting "When this workspace opens, run" does, under its title (Settings → Workspace, HI-1954). Don't wait is the name of a button of the dialog Hive shows.

settings.workspace.onOpen.tip.defaultMessage: Pick them from Commands above. '{reason}' becomes open. If one fails, Combwork asks: Rerun, Skip it and continue, or Stop here; a command ticked "The commands after this need it" leads with Stop here. Only you can set them: the Assistant can't change them.
settings.workspace.onOpen.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "When this workspace opens, run" (Settings → Workspace, HI-1954). '{reason}' is a placeholder the user writes in a command, and open the value it becomes: keep both as they are. Rerun, Skip it and continue and Stop here are buttons of the dialog; the quoted text is a checkbox's label: use their translations.

settings.workspace.onOpen.title.description: A setting's title (Settings → Workspace): the user's commands Hive runs as the workspace opens (HI-1954).

settings.workspace.storage.desc.defaultMessage: What Combwork keeps for each of the workspace's projects (the biggest first) and the Assistant: transcript backups, archived sessions, attachments and worktrees. Storage opens a project's page, with Clean Up… and Purge…; Purge… here removes everything Combwork keeps for the sessions of the whole workspace.
settings.workspace.storage.desc.description: What the setting "Storage" does, under its title (Settings → Workspace). Clean Up… and Purge… are buttons: use their names as translated there.

settings.workspace.storage.tip.defaultMessage: Measured in the background, a project at a time. The coding agents' own transcripts (in ~/.claude, ~/.codex and ~/.copilot) aren't counted. Hidden projects aren't included.
settings.workspace.storage.tip.description: The info tip of the setting "Storage" (Settings → Workspace): more on what it does and when it applies.
